assets.title: Assets
assets.settings.title: Assets
assets.item.title: Asset
assets.methodHint.straight_line: The same amount every month: the usual choice.
assets.methodHint.declining: More in the first years, less later: computers, cars.
assets.methodHint.units: By what it does: kilometres, hours.
assets.rule.next_month: From the 1st of the next month
assets.rule.daily: From the day it is put into service
assets.event.estimate: Useful life or residual value changed
assets.action.in-service.title: Put into service
assets.action.in-service.body: Depreciation starts from this day (or the 1st of the next month, by the company's rule).
assets.action.status.title: Change status
assets.action.status.body: In use, in storage or under repair.
assets.action.move.title: Move to another branch
assets.action.move.body: Its depreciation goes to the new branch from now on.
assets.action.issue.title: Give to someone
assets.action.issue.body: They get a message in the bot and confirm in the app that they have it.
assets.action.issue.done: Given out: waiting for their confirmation
assets.action.return.title: Take back
assets.action.return.body: Note the state it came back in.
assets.action.service.title: Record a service
assets.action.service.body: The next one is planned by its service interval.
assets.action.verification.title: Record an instrument check
assets.action.verification.body: An official check of a thermometer, hygrometer or scales: the storage log needs a valid one.
assets.action.repair.title: Record a repair
assets.action.repair.body: An ordinary repair is a cost of its month: record the payment in Finance under Repairs.
assets.action.addition.title: Add to its cost
assets.action.addition.body: An improvement (a new compressor, an extra section): it depreciates over the life left, from next month.
assets.action.write-down.title: Write down its value
assets.action.write-down.body: Its value fell for good (damage, a cheaper model): the loss is a cost of this month.
assets.action.estimate.title: Change useful life or residual value
assets.action.estimate.body: When it will last longer or shorter than thought.
assets.action.estimate.done: Estimate changed: the months ahead are recalculated
assets.action.suspend.title: Mothball
assets.action.suspend.body: Not used for a while: no depreciation from next month, and its life waits.
assets.action.resume.title: Back in use
assets.action.resume.body: Depreciation goes on from next month over the life that is left.
assets.action.usage.title: Record units of output
assets.action.usage.body: What it did this month: its depreciation follows it.
assets.action.dispose.title: Dispose of it
assets.action.dispose.body: Sold, written off, lost or given away: it leaves the register.
assets.action.status.label: Status
assets.action.repair.improves: It improves it or makes it last longer
assets.action.repair.improvesHint: Then the cost joins its value and depreciates, instead of being this month's cost.
assets.action.estimate.prospective: Months already posted stay as they are; the months ahead are recalculated from its value today.
assets.action.dispose.accountHint: The sale is booked as income on this account.
assets.action.dispose.warning: What it is still worth becomes a cost of that day, and a sale's money is income: the P&L shows the gain or the loss. This can't be undone.
assets.action.write-down.warning: It is worth {value} now. The loss is booked as a cost today.
assets.action.errSold: Give what it was sold for.
assets.action.errReason: Say why it is written off.
assets.register.description: What the company owns, what it is worth today and what it costs every month.
assets.register.emptyBody: Add your fridges, air conditioners, computers and the rest: the app works out what each is worth every month and books its depreciation in Finance.
assets.kpi.bookHint: What they are worth today: cost minus depreciation.
assets.kpi.thisMonthHint: A cost in the P&L that moves no money.
assets.col.name: Asset
assets.purchases.title: Bought equipment? {n} expenses look like it
assets.purchases.body: An expense that bought something for years shouldn't cut one month's profit: turned into an asset, it leaves the P&L and comes back month by month as depreciation.
assets.form.fromPurchaseTitle: Turn the purchase into an asset
assets.form.newDescription: The category fills in its useful life and method; change them if you need to.
assets.form.purchaseBody: This expense leaves the P&L: its cost comes back month by month as depreciation.
assets.form.lockedTitle: Its depreciation is already in the books
assets.form.lockedBody: Cost, life and method are history now. To change what lies ahead, use Change estimate, Add to its cost or Write down on its page.
assets.form.costHint: The price plus delivery and installation.
assets.form.salvageHint: What it will still be worth at the end; usually nothing.
assets.form.lifeHint: How many months it will serve.
assets.form.unitsHint: Everything it will do in its life: kilometres, hours.
assets.form.openingHint: Depreciation from your old books, up to the end of last month. Leave empty to have it worked out.
assets.form.booksHint: Each month's depreciation is booked in Finance as a cost that moves no money.
assets.form.lowValueBody: Kept for who holds it, never depreciated: its cost was an expense when bought.
assets.form.custodianHint: Gets a message to confirm they have it.
assets.form.serviceHint: We remind you a week before.
assets.form.verifyHint: For thermometers and other measuring instruments.
assets.form.errUnits: Give everything it will do in its life.
assets.field.name: Name
assets.item.deleteBody: Only for an asset entered by mistake: nothing of it is in Finance yet, and its purchase goes back to the P&L.
assets.item.chartBody: Solid: posted. Dashed: what lies ahead.
assets.item.scheduleBody: Every month of its life: posted months never change, the ones ahead follow today's value.
assets.item.taxBody: Straight line at {rate}% a year (Tax Code group {group}).
assets.item.taxHint: A temporary difference: your accountant uses it for deferred tax.
assets.item.noFiles: Add a photo, the invoice or the warranty card.
assets.item.labelBody: Print it and stick it on: a scan opens this page.
assets.depreciation.description: What the assets cost each month, by category or branch.
assets.depreciation.explain: Depreciation is a cost that moves no money: profit shows it month by month, cash doesn't. Buying the asset was the cash; this is its cost spread over the years it serves.
assets.movement.title: Movement of fixed assets
assets.movement.body: From {from} to {to}, by category, the way an accountant checks the register.
assets.planning.description: Replacements coming, repairs that cost too much, idle money and upkeep: what to plan for before it surprises you.
assets.planning.kpiReplaceHint: At today's prices grown {rate}% a year.
assets.planning.replaceBody: Assets reaching the end of their life in the next three years, and what a new one will cost then.
assets.planning.replaceEmpty: Nothing reaches the end of its life in the next three years.
assets.planning.repairsBody: In the last 12 months, repairs reached half the price of a new one, or more than it is worth.
assets.planning.repairsEmpty: No repairs approach the price of a new one.
assets.planning.repairsLine: Repairs {repairs} · a new one {price} · worth now {book}
assets.planning.upkeepBody: Services, instrument checks, warranties and insurance: overdue first.
assets.planning.upkeepEmpty: Nothing is due in the next month.
assets.planning.idleBody: In storage or mothballed for two months or more: use it, move it to a branch that needs it, or sell it while it is worth something.
assets.planning.freeBody: Fully depreciated and still in use: no cost any more, but plan its replacement.
assets.planning.unconfirmedBody: Three days or more without the person confirming they have it.
assets.counts.description: Check each branch's assets are where they should be.
assets.counts.startBody: Every asset that should be there gets a line to mark.
assets.counts.emptyBody: A count once a year (and when a branch head changes) keeps the register true.
assets.counts.closeBody: Not checked: {pending}. Missing: {missing}. Missing ones stay on their pages for you to decide.
assets.settings.policyBody: The rules your accountant sets once: when depreciation starts, numbers, what counts as low-value.
assets.settings.ruleHint: NSBU No. 5 allows both; the next-month rule is the usual policy.
assets.settings.ruleLocked: Depreciation is already posted under this rule, so it stays.
assets.settings.thresholdHint: Cheaper things are suggested as low-value items (your accounting policy sets it).
assets.settings.inflationHint: How much dearer a replacement gets each year.
assets.settings.taxBookHint: For profit tax payers: straight line at the Tax Code's rates, with the difference from the books.
assets.settings.categoriesBody: Each one's defaults for new assets: useful life, method, residual value, tax group, service and check months.
assets.settings.legal: The tax rates are the Tax Code's annual maximums (art. 306) as of 2025; useful lives are typical. Confirm both with your accountant.
assets.settings.systemCategory: A starter category: rename it or switch it off freely.
